About

Building Mobile Experiences
That Actually Ship

I'm a Senior Android Developer based in Delhi, India, with a track record of building production-ready apps used by real consumers across India. From e-learning platforms with IoT attendance to devotional apps with 4.8★ ratings, I've shipped across diverse categories with a consistent focus on performance, stability, and user delight.

My tech stack spans Android (Kotlin + Jetpack), Flutter for Android, iOS, Web & Desktop using Riverpod, BLoC, and GetX, Firebase, WebRTC real-time calling, Paytm UPI payments, and AI APIs including OpenAI and Gemini. I also built Priya — a fully deployed AI Hindi voice bot powered by Twilio, GPT-4o-mini, and Sarvam AI TTS, handling live inbound calls with natural Hindi conversation.
